name: motion-diff
description: How a rebuild's motion differs from the original's, run by run, largest first, with side-by-side frames for each run. A repeat of the original sets the noise floor. Cached by content.

verbs.name: compare
verbs.description: Compare two motion-measures, matched by run id. Prints one line per difference, or the diff with --json.

b.description: The rebuild's motion-measures JSON file, from the same run ids.

baseline.description: A second motion-measures file of the original. The gap between it and a widens each tolerance, so random or drifting effects do not report as differences.

departures.description: A JSON list of {run, metric, why} for deliberate differences. Run * matches every run.
